title: Elev8 Mini Recycler
description:
The Elev8 Mini Recycler pairs up awesomely with vapcaps and other vaporizers. It has sweet action and is effective at smoothing out vapour while adding a touch of moisture to your vapour.
Being a small bubbler though if you rip really hard on the mini recycler you can get some unwanted water in your mouth but when you get the hang of  how much you can actually rip on this thing it becomes a unusual occurrence. One thing is for sure this is not a bubbler that will sit on your shelf and not get used.
Joint size is 14mm female
Included
1 x Elev8 Mini Recycler (Choose Colour)
